# Exact library versions used for the analysis (Python 3, macOS/arm64; Apple M2 Max).
# Pinned from the analysis environment. sentence-transformers is intentionally NOT listed:
# models are loaded directly via transformers.AutoModel/AutoTokenizer with manual pooling,
# so the sentence-transformers package is not a dependency.
#
# The embedding step (two_site_v2_analyze.py) requires torch + transformers (+ einops for
# nomic-embed's trust_remote_code); the statistics and sensitivity scripts require only
# numpy + scipy (+ pandas for I/O).

torch==2.2.0
transformers==4.50.3
einops==0.8.2            # required by nomic-embed-text-v1.5 (trust_remote_code)
numpy==1.26.4
scipy==1.13.1
pandas==2.2.3

# Recorded for exact reproducibility (env/capture_env.sh writes these to environment.lock):
#   python --version
#   platform: macOS / arm64 (Apple M2 Max)
#   accelerator: Apple MPS (or CPU); no CUDA
